_meta.source: TNB Domestic ToU (TNB calculator-domesticTOU.js v1.1.65) + JomCharge app Aug 2026. The 2023 EV residential block (home_ev_special RM0.25) no longer exists; home EV charging is billed under the standard Domestic ToU tariff.
notes: home_ev_marginal_rm_per_kwh is the MARGINAL cost of adding EV charging to a baseline 400 kWh/month household under Domestic ToU (10% peak / 90% off-peak overnight charging), validated in scripts/used_market/compute_charging_cost.py. Representative 150 kWh/month EV draw -> RM74.79 marginal bill delta.

AFA is the monthly automatic fuel adjustment (Energy Commission). Waived for households at or below 800 kWh/month until Dec 2026 and 600 kWh/month from Jan 2027; usage_threshold_kwh keeps the long-run 600.
Public rates are JomCharge app prices (AC RM1.10 / DC RM1.40), blended 50/50 -> RM1.25.

tnb_tariffs.home_ev_marginal_note: Marginal ToU cost (baseline 400 kWh household + 150 kWh/mo EV draw, 90% off-peak/10% peak, incl. capacity, network, incentive tier shift; AFA excluded as draw straddles the 600 kWh threshold)

energy_efficiency_incentive.note: Insentif Cekap Tenaga: RM/kWh rebate on ALL usage, chosen by total monthly kWh; none above 1,000 kWh. Transcribed from TNB rates.js v1.1.65, as in scripts/used_market/compute_charging_cost.py.

public_charging_rm_per_kwh.note: JomCharge app Aug 2026 (AC RM1.10 / DC RM1.40), blended 50/50 for the station share

ev_road_tax.note: From 1 Jan 2026 EVs pay JPJ's power-based (kW) schedule (e.g. RM160 at 150 kW, RM280 at 210 kW); the RM2 rate ended 2025. Each catalog row carries its own ownership.road_tax_rm.
